ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: Hi! I'm Sebastian. I'm a Junior Frontend Developer and an absolute CSS maniac. I love bringing designs to life and using my creative mindset and eye for detail to help create digital works of art.
ABOUT.LOCATION_TEXT: Based in Alzey, near Mainz. Generally open to remote positions.
ABOUT.TOOLS_TEXT: I love discovering new tools and expanding my skills with the ones I already know.
ABOUT.CREATIVITY_TEXT: My eye for the little things and my creative mind help me implement many complex designs. I enjoy brainstorming for the best solutions. Alone, but also gladly in a team.
